display_information.name: Foxy
display_information.description: Alerts on new YC and Speedrun companies, and on founders who announce before YC does.
display_information.long_description: Foxy watches the YC startup directory, Launch YC, the a16z Speedrun directory, X and LinkedIn. It posts an alert the moment a new company appears — and, more usefully, when a founder announces a YC or Speedrun acceptance that YC has not yet published. Every alert carries the company name, batch, source, description and a link, plus the founder's own words. State is persistent, so nothing is ever reported twice.
